sources.fact: partial provider coverage; dataset cannot establish absence of an IFS or obligation for every authority/site

examples: 2026 borough CIL rates are charging-zone rates, not a parcel cost until chargeable floorspace/use/relief facts are known
Barking Riverside Zone2 indexed CIL rate is £39.22/sqm for relevant 2026 permissions, but liability still needs scheme-specific calculation
S106 is mitigation/obligation evidence, not proof a contribution has been agreed for a candidate parcel
IFS records receipts/allocations, not guaranteed future infrastructure delivery at a parcel
IDP identifies infrastructure requirements, not funded completion dates
NCIL/SCIL spending demonstrates funding mechanisms, not automatic local uplift
MCIL and borough CIL are separate charging mechanisms and must not be conflated
No financial contribution should be turned into future-growth score without exact development and parcel evidence
